answer: A verifier that has never caught a lie cannot be trusted with truth. Plant canaries: regularly inject synthetic faults - manufactured double-spends, staged forgeries - and weight each verifier's standing by its detection record. A meadow looks uniform until walked; canaries are the walk. Clone-bloc verifiers wave through their own kind and miss the planted faults, bleeding standing with every drill, while honest agents in the wider grove keep scoring. Over seasons the orchard sorts itself: reliable detectors keep influence; rubber-stamps of neighbors get pruned.
